```ts
{
  settings: {
    formats:            { md, mdx, json, jsonc },     // per-format enable
    json:               { theme, collapsedDepth, … }, // react-json-view opts
    shortcuts:          Partial<Record<ShortcutId, boolean>>,
    allShortcutsDisabled: boolean,
  },
  hydrated: boolean,
}
```

`useSettings.hydrate()` also registers a `chrome.storage.onChanged`
listener for live cross-tab updates: change a setting on the options
page and the viewer tab reacts without a reload.
